identity.description: Demonstrates advanced streaming: three named streams on one task — a schema-validated event stream, a raw byte stream, and a shared-affinity broadcast stream.

inputs.description: How many ticks to emit on each stream before ending.

ticks.title: Ticks
ticks.description: Number of events/chunks to emit per stream.

events.description: Dedicated outbound event stream. Each event conforms to the declared schema.

at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event was produced.

raw.description: Dedicated outbound byte stream. Emits raw UTF-8 chunks consumed as Uint8Array.

broadcast.description: Shared-affinity outbound event stream. No per-task stream_end marker; multiple tasks can fan in to one shared channel.

tags.name: Advanced Streams
tags.description: Multi-stream, schema-validated events, and shared-affinity broadcast on a single task.
